The person asks:
When do I have to object to the health insurance contribution notice from Muster BKK?

response.text:
The deadline to object (Widerspruch) to this notice was **Wed 14 Oct 2026**, with a recommended post-by date of **Thu 8 Oct 2026** [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg] — both of which have already passed as today is 30 Oct 2026.

- This to-do is still marked open in your records [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg], so if you haven't filed anything yet, it's past the date Ordnung calculated for sending it.
- Note that even if you had objected, the contribution would still have to be paid in the meantime, since an objection has no suspensive effect [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].
- If you still want to contest the increase, you'd need to check with Muster BKK directly whether a late objection is possible — this isn't something I can judge from the record, and getting advice from the insurer or a student advisory service would make sense here.
